subject: 703 Fellsway West Funding Request
overview: The board heard a presentation from Metro Community Housing regarding $200,000 in emergency funding for project overruns and discussed transitioning the trust's grant-making process to rolling applications.

items.title: 703 Fellsway West Funding Inquiry
items.summary: Metro Community Housing representatives presented a request for up to $200,000 to complete a 3-unit affordable housing project delayed by utility issues and inflationary cost overruns. The board requested an itemized cost breakdown and a formal letter to the contractor regarding liquidated damages before considering the request for a vote.

items.title: Minutes and Rolling Application Discussion
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes for May, June, and July and discussed transitioning from a periodic Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA) to a rolling application process to better accommodate developer timelines. Further discussion on application procedures was tabled until the full board could be present.

items.title: Tabled: Action Plan and Community Meeting
items.summary: Tabled the discussion regarding the action plan and upcoming community input meetings to the next session.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Reviewed upcoming meeting dates, pending board appointments by the Mayor's office, and announced that officer elections will occur at the annual meeting on September 3. Coordination with the Community Preservation Committee regarding housing-related requests was also noted.
